shortDescription: Bitwise CEO said on X that Bitwise Solana Staking ETF BSOL recorded more than $60 million in inflows over the past two days, pushing assets under management above $1.2 billion to a record high. According to ChainCatcher, he also said Solana appears set to be "the Solana" of this cycle.
